title: ee.journal.entry.v1
description: One append-only, redaction-screened agent journal entry (ADR 0062 Appendix A). Emitted under data.entry by `ee journal append`/`ee journal show` and under data.entries[] by `ee journal list`. body, structured, and redactionReport hold post-redaction content only; secrets never reach disk.

entryId.description: UUIDv7 entry id with the jrn_ prefix; time-ordered within a process.

agentName.description: EE_AGENT_NAME at append time; null when unset.

sessionKey.description: Free-form harness session/run identifier (<= 128 bytes) for scoped distillation.

body.description: Redacted observation text; hard cap 16 KiB post-truncation (truncation is deterministic at the last char boundary at or below the cap and reported via the journal_entry_truncated degraded code).

structured.description: Bounded machine-field sidecar; null when no machine fields were supplied. Serialized total <= 8 KiB.

paths.description: Touched paths (<= 16 entries x 1 KiB each).

classesApplied.description: Sorted, deduplicated redaction class names applied at write time.

spanCount.description: Total secret-like spans replaced across body and structured fields.

instructionRisk.description: Policy-screen instruction-likeness grade; entries at or above the configured exclusion grade are skipped by distillation, never blocked at capture.

distilledAt.description: Set by `ee journal distill --apply` (bd-1pi9m.3 idempotency guard).

tombstonedAt.description: Set by retention phase 1 (bd-1pi9m.5); never set by this surface.
